text_overrides.ordinary_2: I'm all right. There's always a blade that needs sharpening.
text_overrides.ordinary_3: Doing fairly well. Nice to have a quiet moment.
text_overrides.content_1: I'm in a good mood, actually.
text_overrides.content_2: Feeling good. I like working on a blade until it's right.
text_overrides.content_3: Well, thank you. Nice to stop for a word.
text_overrides.stressed_2: A bit tense. Best to keep the conversation short.
text_overrides.stressed_3: I've got too much on my mind.
